text:
samuel: heads-up 1 — we got a duplicate webhook in the sampleapp when a 429 landed while the auth token rotated. short repro attached.

anya: ouch. can you paste the tiny repro steps?

samuel: quick repro: 1) kick off createInvoice from quickstart repeatedly until server returns 429. 2) force background token rotation (dev tooling). 3) backoff timer wakes, SDK sees new token version and retries immediately. no idempotency header in quickstart, result: duplicate invoice.

rui: interesting framing: this is a "handshake" race between auth and retry. auth refresh updates token-version, retry loop doesn't verify whether the retry is safe to replay.

samuel: exactly. current SDK only retries on 429 with backoff+jitter. it should also consider token-version changes between attempts and require explicit idempotency or an allowlist for replay.

anya: quickstart parity note: JS quickstart intentionally tiny and omits idempotency, python sample had a note. we should keep tiny but safe. propose a collapsed snippet showing a 1-line idempotency helper.

rui: SDK proposal (sketch): attach a short-lived per-request "handshake" id in the in-memory retry state. when auth refresh happens, the SDK compares handshake token-version and if it changed mark retry as "refresh-handshake-broken". then: if idempotency header present -> replay; if not and policy=error -> surface error; if policy=allow -> replay but emit telemetry + set header `X-Refresh-Replay: 1`. default policy=allow to avoid surprising devs, but document strict mode.

samuel: example minimal quickstart change (collapsed):
```js
// quickstart (collapsed)
const id = makeIdempotencyKey(userId, payload)
await client.createInvoice(payload, { headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': id } })
```

anya: love that. keep it hidden behind a one-line question: "Does this call make persistent changes?" that expands to the snippet.

rui: SDK backoff defaults proposal: base=120ms, cap=1800ms, multiplier=2, jitter=full. plus a small backstop: if token-version changed and idempotency missing, treat retry delay as doubled once to give servers a better chance to surface `Retry-After`. make this configurable.

ops: ops note: we can return an `X-Idempotency-Required: true` on endpoints where server will enforce idempotency. that helps client-side decisions. also include `Retry-After` on 429s.

samuel: telemetry ask: emit `refresh_handshake_mismatch=true/false`, `replay_allowed_by_policy=allow|error|require-idempotency`, and `idempotency_present=true/false` on replay attempts. that will help debug.

anya: doc-bot: we should add a "Handshakes and Safe Replays" section to the DX guide with small table: default behavior, strict mode, recommended quickstart snippet, and server hints. keep it short.

doc-bot: noted. I'll draft the short page and include cross-language examples (JS/Py/Go) and a small diagram for the handshake.

rui: API sketch for SDK options: `client.request(..., { idempotencyKey?: string, refreshReplayPolicy?: 'allow'|'require-idempotency'|'error' })` default `allow`. also expose `onRefreshHandshakeMismatch(cb)` event for integrators who want to log or surface UI warnings.

samuel: small e2e test plan: simulate 429 + forced token rotation during backoff window. assert: with idempotency -> single side-effect; without idempotency + strict policy -> error surfaced; without idempotency + allow policy -> replay occurs but telemetry flagged.

anya: I'll update quickstart copy + add the collapsed snippet. rui, can you write the SDK proposal and defaults? ops, can you help add a server-side flag for idempotency-required?

ops: yes, we can add the `X-Idempotency-Required` header for a few endpoints and `Retry-After` is already standard for rate-limits. will add a small server-side test harness to simulate rotation.

rui: will open an SDK RFC with code sketches and tests for JS/Py/Go parity. propose a tiny compatibility shim so older clients don't break.

doc-bot: I'll slot the new DX section into the quickstart under a collapsed "Production hardening" block.

samuel: action items: @anya update quickstart UX (checkbox + collapsed snippet); @rui RFC + SDK changes; @ops server hints + test harness; @doc-bot draft DX page. target: next Wed EOD. :thumbsup:

anya: thanks team, small UX changes but should prevent a nasty duplication for customers. :)
